message: Turn 52 fixed at e0b28f1566d238e668950a6852dcbd272f9e66e3, Dispatcher 2.2.18. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_reprovision.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_blank.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_finalize.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_rebind.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_replace.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_restore.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_resume.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_reprovision.py test_control_finalize.py test_control_replace.py test_control_resume.py test_control_blank.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_control_rebind.py test_control_page.py test_control_restore.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_control_reprovision.py printed test_control_reprovision: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_finalize.py printed test_control_finalize: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_replace.py printed test_control_replace: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_resume.py printed test_control_resume: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_rebind.py printed test_control_rebind: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_blank.py printed test_control_blank: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_page.py printed test_control_page: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_restore.py printed test_control_restore: OK, exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0. Reprovision semantics: exactly one URL-scoped reprovision applies only when the saved URL is still the old control URL and rebind_for_url, rebind_replacement_for_url, and rebind_finalize_for_url match it; rebind_status=failed; rebind_failure_reason=no_new_url; rebind_bootstrap_sent is exactly true; replacement_count>=1, replacement_status=failed, replacement_failure_reason=no_new_url; finalize_count>=1, finalize_status=failed, finalize_failure_reason=missing_page; and rebind_reprovision_count is 0 with no started/failed/done status. It does not apply to any other failure reason, a missing or false legacy sent flag, a different URL, or an already consumed reprovision. action=ready never starts it. wait, recover, rebind, and send do, because begin_control_rebind still returns wait for this failed rebind and must not be left as the only path. Before new_page the dispatcher persists rebind_reprovision_for_url, rebind_reprovision_count=1, and rebind_reprovision_status=started. These fields are saved inline by save_control_record, so the next poll cannot drop the latch. A restart or later poll never creates a second reprovision page. If status=started and the page marked ai-dispatcher-rebind-reprovision exists, only that page is resumed. If that marked page is missing, the attempt fails closed with reason=missing_page and is permanently consumed, even if another open page shows CONTROL READY. Before any create, a read-only scan of open ChatGPT pages commits a usable new /c/ URL when that page has the exact CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP user message or CONTROL READY. A marker-only user message is not identity. Home '/' is never persisted. Unrelated conversation pages are not navigated. If that proof exists, no page is created. Otherwise one fresh service page is marked before navigation, then opened at https://chatgpt.com/. Composer hydration waits up to 20s. signed_out and hard_unavailable fail closed before send. The legacy rebind_bootstrap_sent=true flag does not suppress this send. Dedicated fields are rebind_reprovision_bootstrap_attempted and rebind_reprovision_submission_status. The attempted latch is written before the single fill. Confirmation uses the 2.2.17 _submit_confirmed poll for up to 8s: exact user message, generation start, or a newly appeared usable /c/ URL. An already-open conversation URL is not treated as confirmation of a send that has not happened. If Enter is unconfirmed and the exact bootstrap text remains, one submit-only retry runs after rebind_reprovision_submit_retry_for_url/count=1/status=started is written. The retry never refills text. After confirmed submit, the dispatcher waits up to 90s (CONTROL_REPROVISION_URL_WAIT) for a usable new /c/ URL and also accepts positive control identity. On success, commit_rebind stores that URL with replaced_from, sets reprovision status=done, marks a bound replacement or finalize latch done, preserves recovery_used, recovered_from, bootstrap_sent, bootstrap_previous_sent_at, and bootstrap_migrated_from, and clears only blank and restore latches. If submit stays unconfirmed, the page is signed out, hard unavailable, the composer never hydrates, goto fails, or no URL appears after confirmed submit, a stable token is stored: submit_unconfirmed, signed_out, hard_unavailable, no_composer, goto, no_new_url, missing_page, unexpected_url, or failed. The attempt is consumed. Later polls hit reprovision_failed_closed and return before finalize, replacement, begin, resume, recover, and provision_control_chat, so no later tab is opened. CHECK_INTERVAL remains 5. Raw GitHub fetch still fails over to the contents API with ref=agent-handoff only after a network failure. Logs do not contain bootstrap text. main remains df4427bb087c08fe19c2d23d50a6cfc588f621d5 and arena/local-agent-v0 remains 91c816b72dd8e91f9b349c9c99bb4a868ed03ded. Phase 2 and the live mailbox were not enabled.
